provenance.note: Those commits are provenance for the semantics these scenarios pin. Neither repository is a dependency of the suite: the scenarios are plain JSON and are executed only by the Python planner.

scenarios.name: parity_cheapest_contiguous_before_departure
scenarios.note: Android ChargingPlannerTest.selectsCheapestContiguousSlotsBeforeDeparture and the web test of the same name. The filler price is 100.0 so it can never be chosen: the siblings plan from a short price list, while this planner plans from whole published days.

scenarios.name: late_night_future_is_unpublished
scenarios.note: Neither planner estimates missing prices: the window needs 2026-09-13's prices, which are not published, so the planner names the gap and price_wait decides what to do about it.

scenarios.name: fiscal_tax_transfer_then_vat
scenarios.note: 100 + 60 + 30 = 190 minor, then VAT of 25 % over the whole sum = 237.5.

scenarios.name: equal_prices_choose_the_earlier_slot
scenarios.note: Two adjacent slots cost the same, so the earlier pair wins by insertion order, exactly as the siblings' ordered maps give.

scenarios.name: period_cap_of_one_forces_one_run
scenarios.note: With one period allowed the two separate 0.1 slots cannot both be taken, so the cheapest legal single run of two slots is chosen instead.

scenarios.name: greedy_selection_would_be_wrong
scenarios.note: With one period allowed, the two cheap slots at 18:00 and 19:00 cannot both be taken. A greedy "cheapest then cheapest" walk would take them and need two runs; the optimum is the adjacent 0.2 pair at 18:30-19:00 local.

scenarios.name: hourly_document_expands_to_quarters
scenarios.note: One hourly row becomes four equal-priced quarter slots.

scenarios.name: spring_day_92_slots_skips_the_missing_hour
scenarios.note: 01:45+01:00 is followed by 03:00+02:00: the hour 02:00-02:59 does not exist locally, and 92 slots cover the whole day.

scenarios.name: overlapping_documents_deduplicate_by_instant
scenarios.note: The first document in the caller's order wins at an overlapping instant.

scenarios.name: missing_tomorrow_at_the_last_published_slot
scenarios.note: The day stops at 23:00, so the very next slot (23:15) has no published price: the candidate window ends there and the named reason is returned, rather than a plan built from a truncated window.

scenarios.name: deadline_too_short_plans_every_slot_to_the_departure
scenarios.note: 10 kWh at 2.3 kW needs eighteen quarter-hours and the departure leaves two: best effort, both of them, from the first usable slot to the departure, marked short of the deadline.

scenarios.name: deadline_too_short
scenarios.note: Not one whole quarter-hour fits before the departure: nothing can be planned, so the reason is named.

scenarios.name: departure_crossing_midnight
scenarios.note: The cheap 00:30 slot ends at 00:45 and so ends after the 00:30 deadline, which is why the next-cheapest slot before the deadline is the answer.

scenarios.name: no_published_prices_at_all
scenarios.note: A plan whose whole window is more than a day after the newest document cannot be filled.
